BEARISH: If industrial demand concerns persist, watch CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.91%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -10.13% | 1M: -17.06%).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Defensive sectors and energy show relative strength; style leadership is mixed. Monitor rising fear and weakness in credit and technology for signs that breadth is deteriorating.
